with_metric.title: Gallery-retention flywheel repaired: per-kind read, prompt-text prior, style feedback
with_metric.target: The flywheel was inert and confounded: the ranking prior matched the report's prompt-mined phrases against the manifest's tags array (slug, provider, use) and scored 0 on all 1,646 images across three shows, and the report pooled Shorts (~55% AVP) with long-form (~15%) so every show's top tag was the 9:16 framing hint. The report now carries by_kind summaries with the prompt boilerplate excluded by name, the prior reads by_kind and matches prompt text, and style_feedback_for hands the scene brief prompt one audience-note sentence when a phrase sits >= 5 points from the kind's median on >= 10 videos. On the 09-22 data every flagship reads None (best long-form tags +4.3 under the bar), so the prompt is unchanged until the data says something. Target: by 10-20 at least one flagship carries a real favoured/avoided pair, scene_brief_style_feedback appears in its metrics, and its long-form AVP is not down against the shows without one. Instrument first; the prompt effect is the readout after.

with_metric.title: Cut the structural digest regeneration rate: shape-only hooks, three validator rules that fired on sections the pipeline itself emptied
with_metric.baseline: 107 of 304 episodes (35%) over Sep 25 – Oct 8 regenerated their digest once: 43 on a hook over 150 characters (omni_view 12/14, first_principles 11/14, modern_investing 5, models_agents 5, UC 4, env_intel 2/2 — every one on a prompt that supplied its own over-limit specimen hook; the shows that include hook_shape.txt ran 0-1 in 14), 41 on a digest lint, 23 on an empty section — Tesla's Short Spot 8/13 (the cross-section dedupe empties it BEFORE the validator and the retry's Short Spot is deduped again: 6 of 8 shipped empty anyway), MIT's one-sentence Listener Challenge (optional, but a present optional section with 0 items read as mandatory). FF spent the separate missing-section retry on 7/13 for a dropped "### Top 15" header above a complete list.
with_metric.target: digest_structural_regen_share_7d <= 0.22 over the 14 days to Oct 23 (from 0.35) with the four control prompts untouched; first_principles and UC hook-length regens <= 2 in 14 each; zero Short Spot / Listener Challenge / Space Stories regens; digest_structural_regen_reasons populated on every regen. Step two, on Oct 13 once the spoken-open experiment is scored: the include goes on omni_view, models_agents, modern_investing and env_intel (28 of the 43 hook regens), and the share target moves to 0.15.
with_metric.criteria: Hit = share <= 0.22 with no new empty-section class appearing in the reasons. The hook include is landmine #17 on UC and FPD — the hook is the spoken open; the operator's A/B-listen of the first episode on each can veto it, in which case the validator fixes stand alone. The four control shows are NOT touched before Oct 13: a prompt change on the control four days before the readout would confound the Sep 22 arm/control read.
